nota_de_formato: um veredito por arquivo e por cena: o mesmo arquivo em duas cenas tem dois vereditos (o veredito vale para a cena da frase_coberta). Casa com o arquivo pelo sha256 e pela cena. rotulo_documento e nota_montagem são campos deste canal: o primeiro é obrigação de tela (identidade §5, 'Documento de outra data que atesta o fato, com rótulo'), o segundo é recado para quem monta, não condição do veredito. No lote 2, aviso_de_ano_motivo explica um aviso_de_ano false (a foto é do tempo da frase); lote e conferido_em vão em cada veredito. No lote 3, frase_coberta.parte diz por qual parte da frase responde cada foto do par ou da mesa, quando o espelho põe duas fotos no mesmo plano. No lote 4, nota_montagem leva também o recorte da legenda datilografada das fotos de 1964 (a versão da Panama Canal Company, que não vai à tela), e serviria_em pode ser uma lista. No despacho pesquisa-4 (conducting): janela_definitiva traz os beats da regência (t no relógio do master), na_tela_s e objeto_s; frase_coberta.janela_s passa a ser o tempo na tela, com janela_provisoria false e janela_provisoria_antes_s; olhado_nesta_conferencia diz se o arquivo foi reaberto; cena_na_regencia aparece quando a cena do espelho foi fundida noutra.

frase_coberta.texto: The rule came by treaty: signed in 1936, in force from 1939. From then on, the Zone had a short list of who could live inside it. People who worked for the United States government, the canal or the railroad, with their families. Members of the armed forces of the United States, with their families. Contractors, a few licensed businesses, church, charity, school and science workers, and everyone's household servants.

frase_coberta.texto: The rule came by treaty: signed in 1936, in force from 1939. From then on, the Zone had a short list of who could live inside it. People who worked for the United States government, the canal or the railroad, with their families. Members of the armed forces of the United States, with their families. Contractors, a few licensed businesses, church, charity, school and science workers, and everyone's household servants.

frase_coberta.texto: The answer is one sentence of law, and it was written in 1937. Being born in the Zone didn't, by itself, make you a citizen of the United States. Under that law, you were one if your father or mother was a citizen of the United States at the time of your birth.
frase_coberta.na_voz: The answer is one sentence of law, and it was written in nineteen thirty-seven. Being born in the Zone didn't, by itself, make you a citizen of the United States. Under that law, you were one if your father or mother was a citizen of the United States at the time of your birth.

frase_coberta.texto: It took effect on October 1, 1979. Its first article "terminates and supersedes" the 1903 treaty, which had granted the band "in perpetuity" to build, run and protect the canal.
frase_coberta.na_voz: It took effect on October first, nineteen seventy-nine. Its first article "terminates and supersedes" the nineteen oh-three treaty, which had granted the band "in perpetuity" to build, run and protect the canal.
frase_coberta.parte: Its first article "terminates and supersedes" the 1903 treaty (plano 2; a data de vigência do plano 1 não está na página)

NOVEMBER 18, 1903.', limpa; cabeçalho em itálico ('Signed at Washington, November 18, 1903; … proclaimed, February 26, 1904'), a proclamação, os plenipotenciários (JOHN HAY e PHILIPPE BUNAU-VARILLA), o Art. I e, no pé, 'ARTICLE II. The Republic of Panama grants to the United States in perpetuity the use, occupation and control of a zone of land and land under water', com a nota de margem 'Isthmian Canal zone granted in perpetuity.'; a finalidade ('for the construction, maintenance, operation, sanitation and protection') continua na p. 2235. Olhada depois de ler a pauta.

frase_coberta.texto: Its own 1940 report explains the names: during construction, common laborers had been paid in silver coin, and skilled craftsmen, recruited largely from the United States, had been paid in gold. By then everyone was paid in dollars, and the names stayed, on pay, on housing, on the commissary, the Zone's own store, and on the clubhouses.
frase_coberta.na_voz: Its own nineteen forty report explains the names: during construction, common laborers had been paid in silver coin, and skilled craftsmen, recruited largely from the United States, had been paid in gold. By then everyone was paid in dollars, and the names stayed, on pay, on housing, on the commissary, the Zone's own store, and on the clubhouses.
